annotations.text:
PALScans — six design directions, three pages each.
A and B follow the familiar dark-violet manga-site layout (marked ASURA-STYLE). C–F are deliberate alternatives.
Same content in every direction so they compare fairly. Pick one direction, or mix: e.g. home from B, series from A, reader from F.
Ad slots are drawn as dashed boxes at final size; footer carries Discord + socials. Covers are placeholders.
Series page for 'Return of the Frost Monarch' in all six directions. Same stats, chapters and actions everywhere.

✓ CHOSEN as the default homepage.
A · Violet Classic (ASURA-STYLE)
The layout your readers already know: carousel hero, updates grid, popular sidebar. Familiar and dense.
Tradeoff: looks like the rest of the category.

B · Violet Refined (ASURA-STYLE)
Same information architecture, calmer execution: one featured card, a card grid, hairlines and glass.
Tradeoff: less content above the fold than A.

C · Editorial Noir
Magazine treatment: one featured story, oversized numerals, whitespace. The most distinctive.
Tradeoff: fewer titles per screen; needs strong art direction to stay fresh.

D · Catalog Grid
Search and filters are the hero. Maximum density, mono numerals. Best for a big catalog and power users.
Tradeoff: no curation on the front page; the least emotive.

E · Daylight
The light theme, proven end to end including the reader. Friendly, broad appeal.
Tradeoff: dark is the category norm; many readers will toggle.

F · Cinematic Rows
Streaming-app feel: full-bleed hero, horizontal rails, glass chrome. Strong on phones and big screens.
Tradeoff: rails hide depth; harder to scan forty updates at once.

Long strip · desktop
Every page in one column, 820 wide. Sticky skyscrapers left and right. Top bar, progress bar, bottom Prev · Chapter · Next.

Paged · desktop (cubari-style)
One page at a time, fit to height. Click the left/right 30% to turn; chapter and page selects; scrubber with a tick per page. Skyscrapers left and right.

Long strip · desktop · chrome hidden
What the strip looks like once the bars slide away: a floating pill and a progress line. H shows the controls again. Skyscrapers stay.

Long strip · mobile · ad every 4 pages
Pages full width, zero gap. The in-strip ad band after page 8 — the interval (off / 2 / 4 / 6) is an admin setting.

Paged · mobile
One page fit to width, tap zones (Previous · Menu · Next) shown once on first run, page counter, scrubber.

Reader settings sheet · mobile
Mode · Direction · Fit · Quality · Preload · Background, plus the Go Premium row that removes ads.

Reader v2 — two modes, both devices.
LONG STRIP: every page loads in one vertical column. PAGED: one page at a time, click or tap to turn, pages load as you go (cubari-style).
Ads: sticky skyscrapers left and right on desktop; on mobile an ad after every N pages, N set in admin (off / 2 / 4 / 6); an end-of-chapter slot in both modes. Premium sees none.
The reader uses a neutral dark palette so it fits whichever homepage direction you pick.

One-click layout switching.
Pick which homepage and series-page version is live (A–F) with a radio card, preview it, save — the cache purges, no deploy. The same screen sets the reader default mode and the reader ad placements: desktop skyscrapers on/off and size, mobile in-strip ad interval, end-of-chapter slot.

Accent colour for the whole site.
Pick one colour; the ramp (hover, dim, wash, text-on-brand, focus glow) is derived for dark and light, with live contrast checks and a component preview. Also: theme default, fonts, radius, density, chip colours.
